name: WF-238 — Seller Response → Negotiation Decision Controller

parameters.jsCode: const d=$json.body??$json;const lead_id=d.lead_id??null,deal_id=d.deal_id??null,property_id=d.property_id??null;const classification=String(d.classification??d.seller_response_type??"").toLowerCase();const counter=Number(d.counteroffer_amount??NaN),mao=Number(d.dynamic_mao??d.adjusted_mao??d.maximum_offer??NaN);const blockers=Array.isArray(d.blockers)?d.blockers:[];let decision="needs_review",state="blocked",route="WF-126",reason="Negotiation inputs are incomplete or require human review.";if(!lead_id||!deal_id||!property_id){reason="Missing negotiation identity.";}else if(blockers.length){reason="Unresolved blockers prevent negotiation decision.";}else if(classification==="accepted"){decision="acceptance_ready";state="negotiation_ready";route="WF-239";reason="Seller accepted the offer; proceed to acceptance/contract decision.";}else if(classification==="counteroffer"){if(!Number.isFinite(counter)||!Number.isFinite(mao)){decision="needs_review";state="needs_evidence";route="WF-237";reason="Counteroffer or dynamic MAO is missing.";}else if(counter<=mao){decision="counteroffer_within_mao";state="negotiation_ready";route="WF-239";reason="Counteroffer is within the protected dynamic MAO ceiling.";}else if(counter<=mao*1.05){decision="counteroffer_near_mao";state="human_review";route="WF-240";reason="Counteroffer is above MAO but within a narrow negotiation band.";}else{decision="counteroffer_above_mao";state="human_review";route="WF-240";reason="Counteroffer materially exceeds the protected dynamic MAO ceiling.";}}else if(classification==="rejected"){decision="rejection_reengagement";state="human_review";route="WF-240";reason="Seller rejected the offer; re-engagement strategy is required.";}else if(classification==="question"){decision="clarification_follow_up";state="negotiation_ready";route="WF-240";reason="Seller question requires a targeted negotiation response.";}else if(classification==="no_response"){decision="follow_up_needed";state="negotiation_ready";route="WF-240";reason="Seller has not provided a substantive response.";}else{decision="other_response";state="human_review";route="WF-240";reason="Seller response requires review before further negotiation.";}return[{json:{workflow:"WF-238",lead_id,deal_id,property_id,classification,counteroffer_amount:Number.isFinite(counter)?counter:null,dynamic_mao:Number.isFinite(mao)?mao:null,decision,state,route,reason,negotiation:{mao_protected:true,within_mao:Number.isFinite(counter)&&Number.isFinite(mao)?counter<=mao:null,over_mao_percent:Number.isFinite(counter)&&Number.isFinite(mao)&&mao>0?((counter/mao)-1)*100:null},requires_human_review:["human_review","blocked"].includes(state)}}];
